name: Xero
one_liner: Xero cloud accounting platform with OAuth 2.0 REST APIs (Accounting, Payroll, Files, Projects, Assets, Bank Feeds).
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code (PKCE) for multi-org apps; Custom Connections (client credentials, single org); MCP also accepts a bearer token.
access_notes: Starter plan: max 5 connections, no payment method, 1000 calls/day/org. Plus and above need App Certification; Advanced/Enterprise need security assessment. Journals, XPM, bulk connections gated.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve Starter tier works but caps at 5 connections; scaling past 50 orgs needs App Certification, premium endpoints need security assessment.
